$comment: Blind rater card. Anchors: ../eval-fun/docs/FRAMEWORK.md section 3, idle boundaries: docs/FUN_EVAL_IDLE.md. bot stays na (caps applied by the coordinator). Rater read only eval/RATING.md, docs/FUN_EVAL_IDLE.md, FRAMEWORK.md sections 1-3, the template, and eval/presets.json weights; nothing else in the repo. Audio unassessed (window.__audio is null on this build; no audible setup).

absences: 8h simulated via ?dev=1&absent=8h after 36 min cold (not a real same-day absence; return scored on the simulated one)

criterion.delayedRecall: same-day: I sent heir 6 with bank-at-D8, five heals and my new free-captive row, and he hit the same D4 archer stall as every heir before him, then took the burst and bloat damage on D6 down to 5/40. He crossed the whole of D7 at 6 hp with the alert at four bangs and monkeys and archers around him while the carried gold ticked from $113 to $151, and my rest rule never got a safe turn to fire. He reached the D8 stair, my bank row fired, and the reel said 'Ashusk the ogre is avenged' — the ogre that had killed heir 5 two runs earlier.

axes.proxy: time-to-first-rule-edit; misread rate on the trace
axes.note: Probe: I always knew what to do next (the death screen ends in three priced patches and 'edit'; camp ends in 'send'), and the HUD told me what was at stake: '$101 · keeps $101 · bank at D8'. Lapse: the stall is not legible — 'stalled · goblin archer, no path · D4 · keeps $0' with a WATCH still that shows an empty room and every row marked 'stuck ← paced 12 turns, foes ignored'; smaller misreads: '1 hp short', 'rest 20m · send skips', callouts 'worth it' / 'not the gold' / 'quick, quick', 'SPENT heal ×1 · −$160'.

Probe: bank at D3 vs D5 on run 3 — the forecast read 'bank 90% · death 10% · ~$30' against 'bank 45% · death 55% · ~$45', I took D3 to unlock rogue and would again; before the night I chose D5 ('bank 90%') over D8 ('bank 21% · death 63%') and on return flipped to D8. Lapse: the forecast's ±22 noise — the same rule set read 'bank 55 · death 25' and 'bank 30 · death 50' minutes apart, so a 10-point edit is unreadable, and a patch worse than base ('on see den → attack nearest · survives 42% · base 50%') was offered first.

Probe: an hour in I can read a bank-depth trade off the forecast, I know 'seen ≥ 50% → descend' drops death from 25% to 75% because early floors feed him, and I know an unknown potion at 5 hp is a coin flip ('Gambled: fire potion', 'Gambled: caustic potion'). But the D4 goblin-archer stall recurred in five of my fourteen runs and neither my edits nor the offered 'stairs seen → descend' patch removed it, so learning plateaued on the thing that cost the most.

Probe: I sweated D7 at 6/40 hp with '!!!!' in the HUD and '$151 carried' next to 'bank at D8', for ninety seconds of monkeys and archers — stakes I chose by setting the bank row to depth 8 and the game noticed with the alert bangs and 'VERDICT'. Lapse: three stalls ended runs by fiat ('Came home empty-handed') and the D1–D3 stretch of every run is watched from full hp.

axes.proxy: frame time; events per minute at 1x
axes.note: Probe: what I actually saw was one good hero sprite on a mostly black map and text callouts ('−3 gas', 'archer draws') every ~3 s; in ten screenshots of fights I never saw a foe sprite, and the bank moment is a sheet, not an event. Controls respond at once (a chip change re-forecasts within a second). Audio unassessed: window.__audio is null on this build and I could not listen.

axes.proxy: death-cause entropy; distinct situations per run
axes.note: Probe: the fire-potion self-kill ('The amber one: fire. Gambled: fire potion.') made me delete the gamble row, and 'A thief snatched the invisibility potion' made me stop buying non-heal supplies; by D7 the cast had bloats, gas, ogres, a conjurer and a spectral blade. Repeats: 'Ulul the jackal, gone wild' and 'A cage: three inside, one to take' in nearly every run, and the identical D4 archer stall five times.

Probe to a friend: a fighter who kites archers, backs off gas, drinks heal under 30%, frees captives and walks straight to the D8 stair to bank — the forecast even labelled my set 'chokepoint' when I wrote the corridor row. But only 3 of 6 rows are mine ('yours: 3 of 6 rows'); the rest are patches and cards the game wrote, and the rows the game wrote are the ones that fire most.

Probe (three sentences): heir 3 crossed the lock on D7 with 'The air stings: bloats ahead', took gas to 5 hp, drank an unknown that was fire and burned to death one hp short; two heirs later the reel read 'Ashusk the ogre is avenged' and heir 6 banked $151 at 6/40. Lapse: the overnight reel is four near-identical lines ('A jackal chased him to 11 HP; R2 drank; reached D5.') and the chronicle is one-line obituaries.

axes.proxy: run length; check-in length; dead time at 1x
axes.note: In-run: a callout every ~3 s, runs of 1–4.5 min at 1x, with dead stretches of eight consecutive 'pick up' reads (25 s) and 30–50 s 'stalling' loops. Check-in: death → patch → send in 1–2 min, forecast live, ends on 'send'. Cadence: 'rest 20m' gates the night to 16 runs, which reads in ~5 min. Lapse: the stall loops eat a third of some watches and the 35-item unlock wall is a long scroll on a phone.

axes.proxy: share of deaths with a matched-rule trace
axes.note: Probe: 'fire · D7 · 1 hp short · 3 unknown unused · gap', five trace rows ending 'R3 drink unknown 5 hp', and a footer that answers every row ('R2 drink heal no item ← R2 drank heal at 13/38 hp') — my fault, the gamble row I took; recovery is one tap. All six deaths named a rule or a gap I could address. Lapse: the three stalls — 'keeps 0%' and 'no path' with every row 'stuck', which I could not fix or explain.

Probe: I decided to push to D8 before the night to learn fire and gas facts, to bank at D3 to unlock rogue, and to free captives because the ledger said 'captive · ally' — none of it asked for. Most unlocks are gated behind facts ('⊘ fact: mirror', '⊘ tame once') I cannot go and get on purpose.

Within-run: kit, $, floor ('$113 → $151'). Between-run: ★0→★5, fighter L1→L4, 'trophy: 10 homecomings', bestiary dots, rows 4→6, two cards, a class. Automation: 'auto: restock' (rebought 14 heals overnight), 'auto: keep weapon+armour', 'path: bones' — three 'no longer need to' in an hour. Lapse: 35 unlocks on one wall, half gated on facts with no route to them, and the class I unlocked gave me no reason to switch.

Probe: the place is a black screen with a lit patch of olive tiles and one well-drawn hero; the floor cards ('D7 · 16 rooms · a lock', 'A den. Something sleeps.') carry more atmosphere than the render. I would not sit in it doing nothing. Audio unassessed.

axes.proxy: offline yield vs active; decisions pending on return
axes.note: Probe: I came back to '16 RUNS · D5 DEEPEST · ◆+9 · 14 BANKED · 2 STALLED · 0 DEATHS', '+$1018 home', L3, 'trophy: 10 homecomings' and a STALL card — 'R6 bank ended 15 runs, none past D5' with 'R6 ↻ depth ≥ 6 → bank' offered; I decided to raise the bank row to D8, buy three unlocks and write a captive rule, within a minute. I would not rather have stayed. Lapse: the reel is four templated lines and '2 STALLED' says nothing about what the stalls cost; absence was simulated, not lived.

axes.proxy: share of deaths attributable to a rule the player wrote
axes.note: Probe: 'I set bank at D8, my heal row saved him at 13/40, my gamble row burned him, and he died because I had no rest rule' — I, my, mine throughout. Six deaths: one on the preset rules, five traced to a row I wrote, took or left out. Lapse: the three stalls, which the screen pinned on 'no path' and every row of mine equally, so I could not connect them to anything I configured.
